sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Pinckney Recreation Area, resourceLocationId -2147483529, map 'Crooked Lake': /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources, /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2026-11-07, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13, 2027-07-17)

values.note: $20 a night at every site in 2026 (DNR rates table, rustic rate) and on every 2026 and 2027 date sampled on the booking site, weekends included. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Pinckney Recreation Area, Crooked Lake map: all 25 campsites on fee schedule -32473, $20 for 2026-10-27, 2026-11-07, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-07-17) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Pinckney, Crooked Lake: Rustic camping rate $20) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/pinckney ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Crooked Lake map: all 25 campsites 'Electrical Service=Not Available', 'Sewer Hookup=No') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates ('Rustic campgrounds include access to vault toilets and hand pumps for fresh/potable water. Electrical is not available.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The booking site allows a trailer or RV up to 25 ft at only 4 of the 25 sites (C7, C8, C14, C23) and up to 20 ft at 4 more (C10, C15, C20, C25); the other 17 take tents (most also truck campers) only. Posted site lengths 30-109 ft. No pull-throughs.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/pinckney (Pinckney Crooked Lake Rustic Campground: 'Number of sites: 25') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Crooked Lake map: 25 campsites; allowed equipment 'Trailer or RV up to 25'' at C7, C8, C14, C23, 'up to 20'' at C10, C15, C20, C25, 'Tents'/'Truck Camper' only at the rest; Site Length 30-109 ft; all 'Pull Through=No'), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/pinckney (Crooked Lake Rustic Campground tags 'Boat launch, Fishing, Fishing pier, Rustic sites, State park campground, Vault toilet') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates ('Rustic campgrounds include access to vault toilets and hand pumps for fresh/potable water'; Pinckney, Crooked Lake: 'Rustic - No modern restrooms'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/pinckney (Pinckney Crooked Lake Rustic Campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Pinckney, Crooked Lake: reservation season starts 'April 1', ends 'November 30') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (25 bookable Crooked Lake campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic campground in Pinckney Recreation Area beside Crooked Lake, near Pinckney/Gregory in southeast Michigan; unimproved boat ramp and fishing pier on the lake; the Potawatomi and multi-use trails are nearby. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + rates table + MiDNRReservations Crooked Lake map: $20 (2026 and 2027, confirmed), no electric, no sewer, 25 sites (confirmed), max 25 ft at 4 sites (new), no pull-throughs, vault toilets, potable water (new), reservable on MiDNRReservations / 800-447-2757, reservation season Apr 1 - Nov 30 (derived -> manual). No operating-season statement, so season stays absent. No closure notice. Phone 734-426-4913 matches. Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Rig length: only 4 of Crooked Lake's 25 sites allow a trailer or RV over 20 ft (C7, C8, C14, C23, up to 25 ft); 4 more are capped at 20 ft and 17 take tents/truck campers only. A 23-ft rig fits at those 4 sites only.
